description: This file defines the UserAvailabilityService class responsible for fetching and processing user availability data, including handling timezones, busy times, out-of-office days, holidays, and limits. It interacts with various repositories and external services to compile comprehensive availability information.

classes.name: UserAvailabilityService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to fetch and process user availability data, including handling timezones, busy times, out-of-office days, holidays, and limits.

methods.name: getTimezoneFromDelegatedCalendars
methods.description: Fetches the user's timezone from delegated calendar credentials, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: _getEventType
methods.description: Retrieves event type details from the repository and parses metadata.

methods.name: _getCurrentSeats
methods.description: Fetches current seat allocations for an event type within a date range.

methods.name: parseLimits
methods.description: Parses booking and duration limits from an event type.

methods.name: _getUserAvailability
methods.description: Main method to compute user availability, including busy times, working hours, out-of-office, holidays, and limits.

methods.name: getUserAvailabilityIncludingBusyTimesFromLimits
methods.description: Fetches user availability considering busy times from limits.

methods.name: getPeriodStartDatesBetween
methods.description: Calculates start dates for periods between two dates, with reporting.

methods.name: calculateOutOfOfficeRanges
methods.description: Calculates ranges of out-of-office days based on user data and availability.

methods.name: _getUsersAvailability
methods.description: Fetches availability for multiple users concurrently.

methods.name: calculateHolidayBlockedDates
methods.description: Determines holiday dates that block user availability based on country settings.
